zh: 新增 `node scripts/worktree.mjs remove <路径>`：`.debug/` 下借主树 `node_modules` 的临时工作树先摘掉顶层链接再交给 git，Windows 上不再顺着链接删掉主树的目录；`scripts/lint.mjs` 只允许这一处发出删除工作树的命令，`packages/testing/` 补一条回归测试。
en: Adds `node scripts/worktree.mjs remove <path>`: a scratch worktree under `.debug/` that borrows the main tree's `node_modules` has its top-level links unlinked before git is handed the directory, so Windows no longer deletes the directories those links name; `scripts/lint.mjs` allows the worktree removal command in that one place only, with a regression test in `packages/testing/`.
